description:
For PMG, the brand difference should communicate that you’re not simply a company that shows up and streams a game. You provide the production, distribution, experience, and infrastructure behind a professional sports broadcast.

The PMG Difference

Premier Media Group goes beyond live streaming. We combine professional broadcast production, experienced crews, advanced technology, and nationwide distribution to create a complete sports media experience.

From a single game to an entire season or national championship, PMG provides the production infrastructure organizations need to deliver a consistent, television-quality broadcast while expanding their audience, strengthening their brand, and creating new opportunities for sponsors.

We don’t just stream the game. We build the broadcast.

For an even harder-hitting website headline:

More Than a Stream. A Complete Broadcast Experience.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to the Premier Media Group Affiliate Program!

Thank you for your interest in partnering with Premier Media Group (“PMG,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). Our Affiliate Program is designed to reward approved individuals and organizations (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”) for introducing potential clients to Premier Media Group and helping us expand our professional sports broadcasting, live streaming, video production, digital media, and related services.

By registering for or participating in the Premier Media Group Affiliate Program (“Program”), you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions.

If you do not agree to these Terms & Conditions, you may not participate in the Program.

1. Affiliate Approval

All applications to the Premier Media Group Affiliate Program are subject to review and approval by PMG.

Premier Media Group reserves the right to approve or reject any Affiliate application at its sole discretion.

Approval into the Program does not create an employment relationship, partnership, joint venture, franchise, agency relationship, or other legal relationship beyond the independent affiliate relationship described in these Terms.

2. Affiliate Referrals & Tracking

Approved Affiliates may receive a unique affiliate link, referral code, promotional code, lead registration method, or other tracking mechanism provided by Premier Media Group.

Affiliates are responsible for using the approved referral methods provided by PMG whenever possible.

A referral must be properly attributed to an Affiliate to qualify for commission. Premier Media Group reserves the right to determine the appropriate Affiliate associated with a referral when multiple Affiliates, marketing sources, or referral methods are involved.

Submitting a referral does not automatically guarantee that the referral qualifies for commission.

PMG may reject referrals that are duplicate leads, existing clients, existing opportunities already being pursued by PMG, fraudulent submissions, self-referrals, or otherwise ineligible under the Program.

3. Qualified Referrals

A Qualified Referral is a prospective client who:

  • Is properly referred or registered through an approved PMG referral method;
  • Is not already an active Premier Media Group client or active sales opportunity, unless otherwise approved by PMG;
  • Enters into an eligible agreement with Premier Media Group; and
  • Makes payment to Premier Media Group for eligible services.

Premier Media Group will make the final determination regarding whether a referral qualifies for commission.

4. Commissions

Affiliates may earn commissions on eligible business generated through Qualified Referrals.

Commission percentages, eligible services, promotional incentives, and other compensation structures will be communicated through the Affiliate Program, Affiliate Dashboard, Affiliate Guide, or directly by Premier Media Group.

Unless otherwise stated in writing, commissions are calculated using eligible revenue actually received by Premier Media Group from the referred client.

Commissions are not earned on amounts that include taxes, refunds, credits, chargebacks, travel reimbursements, equipment rentals, third-party platform fees, venue expenses, subcontractor expenses, pass-through costs, or other amounts determined by PMG to be non-commissionable.

Premier Media Group reserves the right to establish different commission structures for specific services, campaigns, clients, or Affiliate levels.

5. Commission Payments

Affiliates must provide all required payment and tax information before receiving commission payments.

Commission payments will only be issued for eligible client payments that have been successfully received and cleared by Premier Media Group.

Commissions associated with canceled services, refunds, chargebacks, disputed payments, unpaid invoices, or fraudulent transactions will not be paid.

If a commission has already been paid on revenue that is subsequently refunded, charged back, or otherwise reversed, Premier Media Group reserves the right to deduct the corresponding commission from future Affiliate payments.

Payment schedules and minimum payout requirements, if applicable, will be communicated through the Affiliate Program.

6. Marketing & Promotional Materials

Premier Media Group may provide Affiliates with approved marketing materials, including:

  • PMG logos and brand assets;
  • Digital graphics and banners;
  • Promotional videos;
  • Service information;
  • Sales materials;
  • Affiliate links;
  • Social media content; and
  • Other promotional resources.

Affiliates may use these materials solely for the purpose of promoting Premier Media Group in connection with the Affiliate Program.

Affiliates may not alter PMG logos, branding, pricing, offers, or promotional materials in a way that misrepresents Premier Media Group or its services.

7. Affiliate Marketing & Representation

Affiliates may promote Premier Media Group through appropriate online and offline channels, including websites, social media, email, networking, direct referrals, events, and other approved marketing activities.

Affiliates must represent Premier Media Group professionally and accurately.

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false or misleading claims about PMG;
  • Guarantee pricing, availability, services, audience size, revenue, sponsorship results, or production outcomes;
  • Enter into contracts on behalf of Premier Media Group;
  • Commit Premier Media Group to pricing or services without written authorization;
  • Represent themselves as employees or authorized agents of PMG;
  • Use deceptive, fraudulent, illegal, or unethical marketing practices;
  • Send unlawful or unsolicited communications; or
  • Use Premier Media Group's intellectual property outside the scope of the Affiliate Program.

All final pricing, contracts, production commitments, and service agreements must be approved directly by Premier Media Group.

8. Affiliate Links, Codes & Cookies

Premier Media Group may use affiliate links, referral codes, cookies, or other tracking technologies to identify referrals.

When cookie-based tracking is used, attribution may depend on the prospective client accepting cookies and maintaining those cookies on their device.

If cookies are blocked, deleted, disabled, or otherwise unavailable, automatic tracking may not be possible.

The applicable tracking or cookie period, when used, will be identified through the Affiliate Program or Affiliate Dashboard.

Premier Media Group may also manually attribute referrals when sufficient documentation exists to verify that an Affiliate was responsible for introducing the client.

9. Existing Clients & Opportunities

Affiliates generally will not receive commissions for referring individuals or organizations that are already active Premier Media Group clients or documented active sales opportunities.

If an Affiliate believes they have created a new opportunity with an existing PMG relationship, the Affiliate should register the opportunity with Premier Media Group before actively pursuing the referral.

PMG will determine whether the opportunity qualifies for Affiliate compensation.

10. Affiliate Network or Sub-Affiliates

Premier Media Group may, at its discretion, allow approved Affiliates to refer other individuals or organizations to participate in the Affiliate Program.

If a network or sub-affiliate commission structure is offered, the applicable compensation terms will be communicated separately.

Participation in any Affiliate network feature does not automatically guarantee additional compensation.

11. Independent Contractor Relationship

Affiliates participate in the Program as independent contractors.

Nothing contained in these Terms creates an employer-employee relationship, partnership, agency, franchise, or joint venture between the Affiliate and Premier Media Group.

Affiliates are responsible for their own business expenses, taxes, insurance, licensing requirements, and other obligations associated with income earned through the Program.

12. Confidentiality

Affiliates may receive confidential or non-public information regarding Premier Media Group, including pricing, sales strategies, client information, production processes, proposals, business opportunities, or internal materials.

Affiliates agree not to disclose or misuse confidential Premier Media Group information without written authorization.

13. Removal or Termination from the Affiliate Program

Either Premier Media Group or the Affiliate may terminate participation in the Program at any time.

Premier Media Group reserves the right to immediately suspend or terminate an Affiliate for conduct including fraud, misrepresentation, abuse of the Program, inappropriate use of PMG branding, unlawful marketing activity, or conduct that could damage Premier Media Group's reputation or business relationships.

An Affiliate who wishes to leave the Program may contact:

jonathan@thepremiermediagrp.com

Following termination, Affiliates must discontinue the use of Premier Media Group Affiliate links, promotional materials, logos, and other Program assets when requested.

Any outstanding commission eligibility will be determined according to these Terms and the status of the applicable client payments at the time of termination.

14. Program Changes

Premier Media Group reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the Affiliate Program, commission structure, eligibility requirements, promotional offers, or these Terms & Conditions at any time.

Updated terms may be communicated through the Affiliate Program, Affiliate Dashboard, website, or email.

Continued participation in the Program following an update constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

15. Questions & Support

We are excited to have you as part of the Premier Media Group Affiliate Program and look forward to growing together.

Make the connection. PMG handles the production. You earn the commission.

Questions regarding the Affiliate Program may be directed to:

jonathan@thepremiermediagrp.com

Thank you for partnering with Premier Media Group.
